title: Gene Simmons Malibu Crash: Rock Icon Hospitalized
text:
KISS Star Gene ⁢simmons Recovers⁣ at Home After Malibu Car Crash Gene Simmons , 76,​ is recovering at home ⁢after being ⁤involved in​ a single-vehicle car⁤ crash in Malibu, California, on June 3, 2025.The incident occurred when ‌Simmons’ ​SUV crossed ⁣several lanes of⁢ traffic before colliding with a parked car, ⁣according to authorities.
The rock icon, best known as the bassist and co-lead vocalist of the ⁣iconic band KISS, reportedly told law enforcement ⁢he had lost consciousness or fainted prior to the accident. The crash prompted a ‍public response from Simmons,⁤ who assured fans he is “fully fine” and attributed the incident to his‌ self-described poor ‌driving skills. This incident highlights the‌ potential health risks faced by touring⁣ musicians and the importance of medication management, ⁣particularly as performers age.
According to Sergeant Tweed of the Malibu/Lost Hills sheriff’s Station, ​doctors recently adjusted Simmons’ medications and advised him to​ increase his‌ water intake. No injuries were reported as ⁤a result of the crash.
Simmons addressed the incident‌ in a post on‌ X (formerly Twitter) on Wednesday,writing,”I had ‍a slight fender bender. it happens. especially ​to those of us were horrible drivers. and that’s me.⁣ All is well.”
Simmons and KISS have‌ maintained​ a ‍decades-long ⁣career,achieving global recognition for their‌ elaborate ‍stage shows and influential music. The ⁢band concluded its final tour in 2023, but Simmons continues to be an active ⁣presence in entertainment​ and business.
